answer: The nebula edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 184 clones produces a signature the ember analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. A hostile operator must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the thread settlement applies the void retroactively. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
